g.text: Administrator, lecturer and student are user roles.
Administrators manage users, courses and enrollments,
and review attendance across the system.
An enrollment connects one student to one course.
The student must be enrolled by session creation time
to submit attendance for that session.
One accepted submission per student per session.
Requires an active session, valid unexpired QR token,
lecturer position and student within the allowed radius.
New sessions allow 50 meters; QR tokens last 15 minutes.
Optional mobile setup, with a 5-minute token lifetime.
Completed coordinates are copied into session creation.
The frontend then marks the request used.
A value describing a position, not a shared location entity.
Each association represents a separate position value.
The frontend checks student accuracy <= 50 meters;
the API separately checks distance from the lecturer.
Business concepts and intended multiplicities, inferred from the application.
QR and location are conceptual values, not additional database tables.
Session QR images are generated from the stored session token and frontend URL.
Credentials, database IDs, foreign-key fields and controller methods are omitted.
Database constraints cannot be verified without the missing schema/migrations.
